lines.text: The Reubenites, Gadites and half-tribe of Manasseh build an altar at Geliloth, and Israel gathers at Shiloh for war.
Phinehas and ten chiefs say the altar is a breach of faith, like the sin of Sinai.
The Reubenites, Gadites and half-tribe of Manasseh say the altar is a replica, not for sacrifices.
Phinehas and the chiefs are satisfied, Israel blesses God, and the Reubenites and Gadites name the altar Memorial.
